description: This file is a shell script used for testing compatibility and functionality between different Git implementations, specifically focusing on reftable support in JGit and CGit. It sets test environment variables, checks prerequisites, and contains various test cases for repository interactions, reference validations, and ref storage conversions.

methods.name: test_commit_jgit
methods.description: Creates a commit using JGit by touching a file, adding it, and committing with a message.

methods.name: test_same_refs
methods.description: Compares the list of references between CGit and JGit to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_same_ref
methods.description: Checks if specific references in CGit and JGit are the same.

methods.name: test_same_reflog
methods.description: Ensures the reflog entries for a given reference are identical between CGit and JGit.
